_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

prot-tank.purpose: Shield tank: Consecration / Holy Shield / Seal of Righteousness threat, Blessing of Sanctuary, Reckoning swings; mana is the threat resource.
loop: Seal + Judgement of Righteousness (Wisdom for mana)
constraints: mana = threat: Blessing of Sanctuary/Judgement of Wisdom, Reckoning swings with Seal of Wisdom
defense/armor talents are real mitigation but priced at their arithmetic

Anticipation.why: '10 Defense skill, which is the main stat tanks desire... less valuable as your gear improves.'

Improved Devotion Aura.why: 'Devotion Aura is the most commonly used aura for tanking, so it's worth investing points into' - and the melee group shares it.

Reckoning.why: 'Extra swings (especially with Flurry Axe) are always a welcome sight with Seal and Judgement of Wisdom' - threat and mana.

Divine Intellect.why: +10% Intellect: mana for Consecration and Holy Shield, the tank's threat spells; Holy tier-1 path.

Voice of Truth.why: 6 s immunity to silence and interrupts (beta): spell uptime for a tank under interrupts; one point.

Purifying Power.why: Cheaper Cleanse / Purify and -33% Exorcism / Holy Wrath cooldown (beta): dispels and undead / demon threat; two points on the Holy path.

holy-heal.purpose: Flash of Light spam with Illumination mana; Blessing of Kings for the raid; the Protection/Retribution dips are raid buffs.
constraints: raid-buff talents (Improved Devotion Aura, Improved Blessing of Might, Blessing of Kings) are taken for the raid, not the healer's own numbers

Benediction.why: Cheaper Seals/Judgements: small for a healer who rarely judges.

Improved Judgement.why: Judgement cooldown -2 s (beta): keeps Judgement of Light / Wisdom up for the raid when the healer judges; Retribution tier-2 path of the Forever draft.

ret-dps.purpose: Two-hander with Seal of Command and Judgements; Vengeance after crits; mana limits how often you re-seal.
loop: Judgement of the Crusader once, then Judgement of Command
constraints: Retribution tier 1 offers Improved Blessing of Might / Benediction / Deflection - the filler choice is a raid buff, mana or parry
Pursuit of Justice and Repentance are leveling/PvP utility

Deflection.why: Tier-1 Retribution filler (parry) in the raid build; some leveling survivability.

Pursuit of Justice.why: +8% movement: travel while leveling; nothing on a boss.

Benediction.why: Cheaper Seals and Judgements: re-sealing after every Judgement is the mana sink.

Improved Blessing of Might.why: Raid attack power; small for you.

Improved Seal of the Crusader.why: Judgement of the Crusader debuff feeds every Holy hit.

Conviction.why: 5% crit; low while leveling, core at 60.

Sanctity Aura.why: Brings sanctity aura to 1 others (a party aura (+10% holy damage): one other retribution paladin in the group (Classic raids field few); computed from the tooltip because the simulator's paladin always runs its own aura option); worth classic-era: +2.6% per receiver (buff_value.py).

Consecration.why: One point: an area threat and damage tool for trash and farming; the simulator's raid rotation casts it rarely, so the raid value is small.

Divine Intellect.why: +10% Intellect: mana for seals and judgements over a five-minute fight; Holy tier-1 path.
